method: 2026-10-31 cross-repository W0X rewrite. One record per row of this spec: action, decisions, retirement reason, new children, rows requested in other specs, cross edits requested of other rows, and harness consumer notes. Rules: one row standard, production caller chain, served proof, both sides declared, knobs, ecosystem boundaries.

cross_edits_requested.change: Compute plan_digest with scion_sdk.writeback.wallet_intent.wallet_plan_digest so both repositories hash the same bytes.
Import WalletBusinessIntent and WalletExecutionEnvelope from scion_sdk.writeback.wallet_intent.

decisions: Prior-effect lookup runs before proof verification so an expired proof cannot hide a recorded receipt; authorization is still re-checked.

Wallet key trust record and read method

cross_edits_requested.change: Name the emerald-exchange wallet tool (NEW:14) as the connector call that composes the SDK proof gate.

decisions: The existing emerald write-back sink stays propose-only; wallet operations use a distinct sink flag requires_wallet_proof.

new_rows_requested.title: Repository file write tool over the SDK repository effect transport

cross_edits_requested.change: Cite SCION-GOVERNED-WRITEBACK-R004.12 and the github-agent tool of NEW:8 as the producer.
Name Method::WriteBack Create, RecordAttempt, RecordReconciliation and Receipts as the served ledger that the SDK repository effect uses, with their refusal codes.

decisions: One shared RepositoryEffectTransport lives in the SDK; connectors implement only RepositoryProviderPort.

decisions: The sink fetches the release from the engine itself; a caller-supplied approval flag is removed (hard cutover).
The release id is the change_set_id of MEDULLA-DECISION-ENGINE-R615.3.
